have helper : ∀ (c : G) (r : ℕ), orderOf c = r → ∀ (y : G), y ∈ Subgroup.zpowers c → y ^ r = 1 := by
  intro c r hr y hy
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp hy
  have hc : c ^ r = 1 := by
    rw [← hr]
    exact pow_orderOf_eq_one c
  have hcz : c ^ (r : ℤ) = 1 := by
    rw [zpow_natCast, hc]
  calc
    y ^ r = (c ^ k) ^ r := by rw [← hk]
    _ = c ^ (k * (r : ℤ)) := by rw [← zpow_natCast, zpow_mul]
    _ = c ^ ((r : ℤ) * k) := by congr 1; exact mul_comm k (r : ℤ)
    _ = (c ^ (r : ℤ)) ^ k := by rw [← zpow_mul]
    _ = 1 := by rw [hcz, one_zpow]

let mat : ℂ → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := fun z => !![z.re, z.im; -z.im, z.re]
have mat_one : mat 1 = 1 := by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [mat]
have mat_zero : mat 0 = 0 := by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [mat]
have mat_add (z w : ℂ) : mat (z + w) = mat z + mat w := by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [mat] <;> ring
have mat_mul (z w : ℂ) : mat z * mat w = mat (z * w) := by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [mat, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im] <;> ring
let matHom : ℂ →+* Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
  { toFun := mat
    map_one' := mat_one
    map_mul' := fun z w => (mat_mul z w).symm
    map_zero' := mat_zero
    map_add' := mat_add }
have mat_injective : Function.Injective mat := by
  intro z w h
  apply Complex.ext
  · have h00 := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ => A 0 0) h
    simpa [mat] using h00
  · have h01 := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ => A 0 1) h
    simpa [mat] using h01

have φ_injective : Function.Injective φ := by
  intro z w h
  apply Units.ext
  apply mat_injective
  exact congrArg Units.val h
let H : Subgroup (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)ˣ := φ.range
have membership_characterization (M : (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)ˣ) :
    M ∈ H ↔ ∃ a b : ℝ, (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) = !![a, b; -b, a] := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := MonoidHom.mem_range.mp h
    refine ⟨z.val.re, z.val.im, ?_⟩
    have hv := congrArg Units.val hz
    simpa [φ, mat, matHom] using hv.symm
  · rintro ⟨a, b, h⟩
    have hc : (⟨a, b⟩ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc0
      have hre := congrArg Complex.re hc0
      have him := congrArg Complex.im hc0
      simp at hre him
      have hz : (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) = 0 := by
        rw [h]
        ext i j
        fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [hre, him]
      exact Units.ne_zero M (congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ => A) hz)
    let c : ℂˣ := Units.mk0 ⟨a, b⟩ hc

      apply Units.ext
      change mat c.val = (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
      simpa [c, φ, mat, matHom] using h.symm
    exact MonoidHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨c, hφ⟩

  · intro y
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := MonoidHom.mem_range.mp y.property
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hz

have hcoef := hs' (fun _ : Fin 1 => 1) (by simp)
have hnot : (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
  intro heq
  have := congrFun heq 0
  norm_num at this
exact hnot (funext hcoef)

intro F _ V _ _ v h
let T : Submodule F V := Submodule.span F (Set.range (fun i : Fin 4 => if i.val = 0 then v 0 - v 1 else if i.val = 1 then v 1 - v 2 else if i.val = 2 then v 2 - v 3 else v 3))
let S : Submodule F V := Submodule.span F (Set.range v)
have h0 : v 0 - v 1 ∈ T := by
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  simp [T]
have h1 : v 1 - v 2 ∈ T := by
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp [T]
have h2 : v 2 - v 3 ∈ T := by
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
  simp [T]
have h3 : v 3 ∈ T := by
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  refine ⟨3, ?_⟩
  simp [T]
have hv3 : v 3 ∈ T := h3
have hv2 : v 2 ∈ T := by
  have heq : v 2 = (v 2 - v 3) + v 3 := by
    exact (sub_add_cancel (v 2) (v 3)).symm
  rw [heq]
  exact T.add_mem h2 hv3
have hv1 : v 1 ∈ T := by
  have heq : v 1 = (v 1 - v 2) + v 2 := by
    exact (sub_add_cancel (v 1) (v 2)).symm
  rw [heq]
  exact T.add_mem h1 hv2
have hv0 : v 0 ∈ T := by
  have heq : v 0 = (v 0 - v 1) + v 1 := by
    exact (sub_add_cancel (v 0) (v 1)).symm
  rw [heq]
  exact T.add_mem h0 hv1
have hST : S ≤ T := by
  apply Submodule.span_le.2
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨i, rfl⟩
  fin_cases i <;> simp [T] at *
  · exact hv0
  · exact hv1
  · exact hv2
  · exact hv3
change T = ⊤
apply le_antisymm
· exact le_top
· rw [← h]
  exact hST

intro h
let F := ℝ
let V := Fin 4 → ℝ
let b : Module.Basis (Fin 4) ℝ V := Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 4)
let v : Fin 4 → V := fun i => b i
let L : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ := b.coord 2 - b.coord 3
let U : Submodule ℝ V := L.ker
have hv_ind : LinearIndependent ℝ v := by
  simpa [v] using b.linearIndependent
have hcoord : ∀ i j : Fin 4, b.coord j (b i) = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
  intro i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp
  · simp [hij]
have hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) = ⊤ := by
  apply (Submodule.eq_top_iff').2
  intro x
  rw [← b.sum_repr x]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro i hi
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
have hv0 : v 0 ∈ U := by
  change L (v 0) = 0
  simp [L, v, hcoord]
have hv1 : v 1 ∈ U := by
  change L (v 1) = 0
  simp [L, v, hcoord]
have hv2 : v 2 ∉ U := by
  change L (v 2) ≠ 0
  simp [L, v, hcoord]
have hv3 : v 3 ∉ U := by
  change L (v 3) ≠ 0
  simp [L, v, hcoord]
have zmem : v 2 + v 3 ∈ U := by
  change L (v 2 + v 3) = 0
  simp [L, v, hcoord]
have hcontain : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (fun i : Fin 2 => v (Fin.castLE (by decide) i))) ≤ (b.coord 2).ker := by
  apply Submodule.span_le.2
  rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
  fin_cases i <;> change b.coord 2 (v (Fin.castLE (by decide) _)) = 0 <;> simp [v, hcoord]
have znot : v 2 + v 3 ∉ (b.coord 2).ker := by
  change b.coord 2 (v 2 + v 3) ≠ 0
  simp [v, hcoord]
have hresult := h F V v U hv_ind hspan hv0 hv1 hv2 hv3
rcases hresult with ⟨_, heq⟩
apply znot
apply hcontain
rw [heq]
exact zmem

intro h
obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := h (1 : Polynomial ℝ)
have hzero := hT 0

intro F _ V _ _ _ R S T h
apply (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective).2
intro y
obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h (R y)
have hRinj : Function.Injective R := (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective).2 (by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h z
  exact ⟨(S.comp T) w, by simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using hw⟩)
have hxy : (S.comp T) x = y := hRinj (by
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using hx)
exact ⟨T x, by simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using hxy⟩

intro F _ V _ _ _ U hU
by_cases hbot : U = ⊥
· exact Or.inl hbot
· right
  classical
  let b := Module.finBasis F V
  have hu_exists : ∃ u, u ∈ U ∧ u ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    push_neg at hn
    have hzero : U = ⊥ := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        have hx0 := hn x hx
        simpa using hx0
      · intro hx
        have hx0 : x = 0 := by simpa using hx
        simpa [hx0]
    exact hbot hzero
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hu0⟩ := hu_exists
  have hrepr : b.repr u ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    apply hu0
    apply b.repr.injective
    simpa using heq
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hrepr)
  have hc : b.coord i u ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [Module.Basis.coord_apply] using hi
  have htop : U = ⊤ := (Submodule.eq_top_iff'.2 fun v => by
    let c := b.coord i u
    let T : V →ₗ[F] V := LinearMap.smulRight (b.coord i) (c⁻¹ • v)
    have hTu : T u ∈ U := hU T u hu
    have heval : T u = v := by
      change c • (c⁻¹ • v) = v
      rw [← smul_assoc, smul_eq_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]
    rw [heval] at hTu
    exact hTu)
  exact htop

intro h
let A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := !![1, 0; 0, 2]
let B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := !![0, 1; 0, 0]
have hA : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → A i j = 0 := by
  intro i j hij
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [A] at *
have hB : ∀ i j, j < i → B i j = 0 := by
  intro i j hji
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [B] at hji ⊢
have hmul : A * B = B * A := h (F := ℝ) 2 A B hA hB
have heq := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ => M 0 1) hmul
have hab : (A * B) 0 1 = 1 := by
  norm_num [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, A, B]
have hba : (B * A) 0 1 = 2 := by
  norm_num [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, A, B]
change (A * B) 0 1 = (B * A) 0 1 at heq
rw [hab, hba] at heq
norm_num at heq

intro B hsym hpos
let e0 : Fin 2 → ℝ := fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0
let e1 : Fin 2 → ℝ := fun i => if i = 1 then 1 else 0
let p : Fin 2 → ℝ := e0 + e1
let m : Fin 2 → ℝ := e0 - e1
have he0 : e0 ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have := congrFun h 0
  dsimp [e0] at this
  norm_num at this
have he1 : e1 ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have := congrFun h 1
  dsimp [e1] at this
  norm_num at this
have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have := congrFun h 0
  dsimp [p, e0, e1] at this
  norm_num at this
have hm : m ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have := congrFun h 0
  dsimp [m, e0, e1] at this
  norm_num at this
have hc0 : max |e0 0| |e0 1| = 1 := by
  norm_num [e0]
have hc1 : max |e1 0| |e1 1| = 1 := by
  norm_num [e1]
have hcp : max |p 0| |p 1| = 1 := by
  norm_num [p, e0, e1]
have hcm : max |m 0| |m 1| = 1 := by
  norm_num [m, e0, e1]
by_contra hn
push_neg at hn
have hall : ∀ v, Real.sqrt (B v v) = max |v 0| |v 1| := hn
have he0sq : B e0 e0 = 1 := by
  have h := hall e0
  rw [hc0] at h
  have hsq := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) h
  change (Real.sqrt (B e0 e0)) ^ 2 = (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 at hsq
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (hpos e0 he0))] at hsq
  norm_num at hsq
  exact hsq
have he1sq : B e1 e1 = 1 := by
  have h := hall e1
  rw [hc1] at h
  have hsq := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) h
  change (Real.sqrt (B e1 e1)) ^ 2 = (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 at hsq
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (hpos e1 he1))] at hsq
  norm_num at hsq
  exact hsq
have hpsq : B p p = 1 := by
  have h := hall p
  rw [hcp] at h
  have hsq := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) h
  change (Real.sqrt (B p p)) ^ 2 = (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 at hsq
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (hpos p hp))] at hsq
  norm_num at hsq
  exact hsq
have hmsq : B m m = 1 := by
  have h := hall m
  rw [hcm] at h
  have hsq := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) h
  change (Real.sqrt (B m m)) ^ 2 = (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 at hsq
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (hpos m hm))] at hsq
  norm_num at hsq
  exact hsq
have hsum : B p p + B m m = 2 * (B e0 e0 + B e1 e1) := by
  simp only [p, m]
  simp [map_add, map_sub, hsym] <;> ring
rw [hpsq, hmsq, he0sq, he1sq] at hsum
norm_num at hsum
